target.what: Number of bottles of Zhenjiang Hengshun (恒顺) vinegar (all bottled vinegar types combined, excluding bulk/industrial drums) sold/exported to the United States by Jiangsu Hengshun Group (镇江恒顺集团 / 江苏恒顺醋业股份有限公司) in a full calendar year
target.publisher: None official; Hengshun Group / Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd. (SH:600305) annual report and China customs export statistics are the closest reporting sources
target.cadence: Annual (company annual report; customs trade data monthly/annual)
target.caveats: No public source reports Hengshun's US-bound bottle count directly. Working interpretation: calendar year 2024 (most recent completed year before the 2026-10-18 cutoff), all bottled vinegar SKUs, counted as physical bottles shipped to the US (export shipments), not retail sell-through. Alternatives

candidates.hypothesis: Hengshun's annual report discloses total revenue and possibly overseas/export revenue or volume; overseas revenue × US share of overseas revenue gives US export value, which divided by average export bottle price gives bottle count. Direction: higher overseas revenue implies more US bottles.

(600305) annual reports 2022-2024: total vinegar sales volume (tonnes), overseas/export revenue (境外收入 or 出口收入), any disclosed export volume, and average selling price per tonne or per bottle. Minimum: one year's overseas revenue plus a US share proxy.

methods.rationale: Company-side route: export revenue (p137) × US share × vinegar share ÷ price per litre ÷ bottle fill. Shared dependency: a1 and a2 are unobserved splits of the export mix; a3 and a4 are conversion factors. Failure mode: if Hengshun's US business is much smaller than its export mix implies, this overstates.

methods.rationale: Destination-side route: 2024 US-bound HS22090000 value (p108) × Hengshun value share ÷ Hengshun price per litre ÷ bottle fill. excluded_by_input_audit.label: m3
excluded_by_input_audit.reason: unit check: the formula's result is 'tonne*bottle/(L*year)' (tonne/year * 1 * 1 / (L/bottle) = tonne*bottle/(L*year)), which is not a 'bottle' quantity: you judged that it does not fit the target unit 'bottle': The formula divides a mass (tonne) by a volume-per-bottle (L/bottle), giving tonne*bottle/(L*year); this is a mass-per-volume rate, not a count of bottles. Converting to bottle would need a density (tonne/L) that the formula lacks, so it is not the same kind of quantity as bottle.

kept.name: US share of Hengshun export-mode revenue
kept.rationale: Hengshun export-mode revenue (p137) covers all destinations and products. The US is ~11-17% of China's vinegar export volume/value (p3, p108/p110), the largest non-Hong-Kong market. ImportGenius shows only 44 US shipments over 2006-2022 (p76), suggesting the US is important but not dominant; set 20%
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's export destination mix resembles the national HS22090000 mix with the US as a leading branded market.
kept.falsified_by: Distributor disclosures showing only a few containers/year, or evidence most exports go to Hong Kong/SE Asia.

kept.name: Vinegar share of Hengshun export-mode revenue
kept.rationale: Vinegar is ~58% of Hengshun total revenue (p142/p145) and is the flagship export product; export mix likely skews toward vinegar but includes sauce and wine. Set 60% central.
kept.applies_when: Export product mix broadly resembles domestic mix, tilted toward vinegar.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence Hengshun exports mostly sauce or cooking wine.

kept.name: Average Hengshun export price per litre (CNY)
kept.rationale: China HS22090000 export unit value from p2/p1 is ~1.28 USD/litre (~9.2 CNY/litre at ~7.2 CNY/USD); Hengshun branded product sells at a premium but export FOB prices are below US retail. Set 8 CNY/litre central.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun export FOB price per litre is near the national HS22090000 average, adjusted for brand premium.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of Hengshun export invoice prices materially different from the national average.

kept.name: Average bottle fill for US-bound Hengshun vinegar
kept.rationale: US distributor SKU list (p51-p62) is dominated by 500ml with some 535/550/580ml; weighted average ~0.52L. Bill of lading (p30) shows 550ml.
kept.applies_when: US-bound SKU mix resembles the Five Continents catalogue.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that US-bound Hengshun is mostly large-format or bulk packaging.

kept.name: Hengshun share of China HS22090000 exports to the US by value
kept.rationale: Hengshun is China's largest vinegar producer and best-known branded exporter; branded product commands a value premium over many small bulk exporters. Set 30% central with wide range.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun is the leading branded supplier among Chinese vinegar exporters to the US.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's US-bound value is a small share of the ~5M USD total.

kept.name: Average Hengshun US-bound export price per litre (USD)
kept.rationale: National HS22090000 US-bound unit value from p2/p1 is ~1.28 USD/litre; Hengshun branded product should price above the national average. Set 1.6 USD/litre central.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun US FOB price is modestly above the national HS22090000 average.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of Hengshun US invoice prices near or below the national average.

kept.name: Hengshun export share of vinegar sales volume
kept.rationale: Export-mode revenue is ~2.2% of total revenue (p137/p145); vinegar export share of vinegar volume should be similar order, slightly higher if export mix skews to vinegar. Set 3% central.
kept.applies_when: Export revenue share approximates export volume share for vinegar.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that export prices are much higher or lower than domestic, shifting the volume share.

kept.name: US share of Hengshun vinegar export volume
kept.rationale: Same logic as a1: the US is a leading branded market for Chinese vinegar; set 20% central.
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's vinegar export destination mix resembles the national mix.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's US volume is a small fraction of its exports.

residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.

The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
